blocks.arabic_text: بِاللهِ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ: (فَاجْتَنِبُوا الرِّجْسَ مِنَ اْلاَوْثَانِ وَاجْتَنِبُوْا قَوْلَ الزُّوْرِ ۞ حُنَفَاءَ لِلّهِ غَيْرَ مُشْرِكِيْنَ بِه۞).
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (الحج:٣١،٣٠) رواه ابو داؤد، باب في شهادة الزور، رقم: ٣٥٩٩
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Khuraim ibn Fatik (RA) says, “One day the Prophet ﷺ prayed Fajr. When he finished the Salah, the Prophet ﷺ stood up and said three times, “Bearing false witness has been made equal to associating partners with Allah Ta'ala.” Then the Prophet ﷺ ( ) recited the ayah: “So avoid the filth of idol worship, and avoid bearing false witness, becoming devoted to Allah alone, not associating anyone with Him as a partner.”

blocks.text:
Explanation:- Bearing false witness is a filthy sin like Shirk (associating partners) and idol worship. The meaning of this hadith is that just as the people of Iman keep away from associating partners and worshipping idols, they must also keep away from bearing false witness.
(Ma'ariful Hadith)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ اُمَامَةَ ﵁ اَنَّ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: مَنِ اقْتَطَعَ حَقَّ امْرِئئٍ مُسْلِمٍ بِيَمِيْنِهِ، فَقَدْ اَوْجَبَ اللهُ لَهُ النَّارَ، وَحَرَّمَ عَلَيْهِ الْجَنَّةَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ: وَاِنْ كَانَ شَيْئًا يَسِيْرًا يَا رَسُوْلَ اللهِ؟ قَالَ وَاِنْ قَضِيْبٌ مِنْ اَرَاكٍ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم، باب وعيد من اقتطع حق مسلم...،رقم: ٣٥٣
blocks.tamil_translation: When Rasulullah ﷺ said, “Whoever snatches the property of a Muslim by swearing a (false) oath, Allah Ta'ala makes Jahannam obligatory for him and makes Jannah haram for him,” a man asked, “Ya Rasulallah, even if it is a trivial thing?
